style.styleTitle: Homcom 4ft Prelit Artificial Christmas Tree With Metal Base
style.toneOfVoice: This Christmas tree with lights and a glowing star from HOMCOM is a great addition to your festive celebrations and a great focal point in your room. The built-in fibre optic light stays lit when turned on and will create a soft glow around the tree using three colours combination. Made from PVC with a fresh cut look, and with a metal stand to keep your tree firmly secured while in use. It is also made to last for years with easy folding and disassembly ready for the next year.<br>&nbsp;- Pine styled tree stands up tall;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Made of dense PVC needles with branches with natural look to last all season;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Pre-lit colourful optical fibre lights expanding the whole tree;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Includes a star topper attached to the tree adding a festival glow to your home;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Sturdy foldable metal base provides stability to keep your tree standing firm;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Easy to assembly and disassemble for storage;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Perfect for indoor decoration at Christmas, creating festive mood;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- RECOMMENDED SETUP: For the fullest results, work from bottom to top spreading every branch in a spiral motion;<br>&nbsp;- Item Name: Christmas Tree;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Brand Name: HOMCOM;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Material: PVC, Metal Stand;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Colour: Green;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Overall Dimension: 4FT: F70x120H (cm). 5FT: F60x150H (cm);&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Branch Tip: 4FT: 130. 5FT: 180;<br>&nbsp;- Transformer Voltage: 100-240V 50/60Hz;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Cord Length: 1.8m;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Power: 3.6W;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Flat Pack: YES;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Certification: CE, ROHS;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;- Assembly Required: YES.
